units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 5:1">Bekh. V, 1</cite> <he>שוקלין מ׳ כנגד מ׳</he> you must weigh one piece (of the meat of the first-born) against another piece (of secular meat of ascertained weight).
<cite ref="Gittin 59b:9">Gitt. 59ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>ליטול מ׳ מ׳ יפה ראשון</he> that he (the priest) have the privilege of first choice (when a division is made).
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 53:2">Sifré Deut. 53</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 875:3">Yalk. ib. 875</cite> <he>מ׳ יפה</he> the best portion (at the meal).

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 765:35">Yalk. Num. 765</cite>, end <he>מלך שבירר לעצמו מ׳ וכ׳</he> a king who selected a portion for himself, and another came and spoke disparagingly of it; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מָנוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 149a:6">Sabb. 149ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 17:5">Tosef. ib. XVII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 18:5">XVIII</cite>), 5.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 18:4">Ib. 4</cite> <he>מפיסין על מָנוֹתֵיהֶן</he> cast lots for their portions (at the table); a. e.—V. <cite ref="M01820"><he>מְנָת</he></cite>.
